newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end higher, boosted by demand for cash bonds.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end higher, boosted by demand for cash bonds.

text.p: *Key June JGB futures ended higher, boosted by investors' strong appetite for cash JGBs.
*Comments by U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, which contained no new references about need for Japan to stimulate its economy, also provided psychological support.
